referenceSources.description:
A white Mazda Lantis Coupe Type X, decked out in Castrol and Sapio sponsorship colors, races around a damp circuit. The green and red stripes run along the hood and sides, while the number 6 and driver name “Y. Terada” are prominently displayed on the door and window. The car’s aerodynamic front splitter and rear wing hint at its touring car setup.

This photograph captures the Lantis in action during the 1994 Japanese Touring Car Championship (JTCC). The wet track surface and blurred background emphasize the car’s speed and handling. The Castrol‑branded livery and Michelin tires reflect the era’s motorsport partnerships, showcasing Mazda’s effort to compete with its V6‑powered Lantis against four‑cylinder rivals.
